skills.name: briefing-an-account
skills.description: Assemble a pre-call account brief in Topo — roster, open sequences, inbox threads, recent activity, and ICP fit — then leave a next step if asked. Use when the user asks to brief an account, who we are talking to at a company, or what happened with a lead this month.
skills.description_zh: 在 Topo 汇总通话前客户简报，包括联系人、进行中触达序列、收件箱讨论、近期活动及理想客户画像匹配，可按要求留下下一步。

skills.name: clearing-todays-tasks
skills.description: Work the Topo task inbox — list what is due, then complete, skip, snooze, or reassign with the payload each task type requires. Use when the user asks what is on their plate, to clear hot tasks, log a call, snooze a follow-up, or hand a task to a teammate.
skills.description_zh: 处理 Topo 任务收件箱，列举到期事项并按任务类型所需数据完成、跳过、延后或重新分配，支持通话记录和跟进管理。

skills.name: creating-a-lead-search
skills.description: Source new leads from criteria using Topo lead search, preview or run the search with explicit user confirmation, and import matching leads into a contact list. Use when the user wants to find new prospects, build a target list from scratch, or source leads matching specific titles, locations, or companies.
skills.description_zh: 按职位、地区或公司条件在 Topo 查找新线索，经用户明确确认预览或运行搜索，并导入匹配联系人到名单。

skills.name: creating-a-sequence
skills.description: Author a new Topo outreach sequence from a name and ordered steps, clone an existing one, or replace the copy of a template. Use when the user wants to create a sequence, duplicate one, or edit subjects, bodies, delays, or channels.
skills.description_zh: 在 Topo 按名称和有序步骤创建触达序列、复制既有序列或替换模板文案，支持主题、正文、延迟和渠道编辑。

skills.name: diagnosing-sequence-health
skills.description: Diagnose why a Topo sequence is not sending or underperforming using funnel counts and operational settings, then apply only the ops fixes MCP allows. Use when the user asks why a sequence is quiet, how it performed this month, to pause it, attach a sender, or switch copilot vs autopilot.
skills.description_zh: 根据 Topo 漏斗数量及运行设置诊断序列未发送或效果差的原因，仅应用 MCP 支持的运维修复，支持暂停、绑定发送者及 copilot／autopilot 切换。

skills.name: getting-started-with-topo
skills.description: Orient a Topo session — confirm who is signed in, take stock of the workspace, and route the request to the right Topo skill. Use when the user asks what Topo can do, whether they are connected, what is in their workspace, or gives an outbound sales request that does not obviously match another Topo skill.
skills.description_zh: 确认 Topo 登录身份、盘点工作区并将请求路由到合适技能，适用于能力介绍、连接检查和不明确的主动销售请求。

skills.name: holding-or-resuming-outreach
skills.description: Temporarily pause Topo outreach for out-of-office, vacation, or bad timing, and resume it later, without marking people lost. Use when the user wants to pause a lead until a date, freeze a whole sequence this week, or resume paused enrollments.
skills.description_zh: 因外出、休假或时机不合暂时暂停 Topo 触达并随后恢复，不将联系人标记为流失，支持按日期暂停线索、整序列冻结和恢复参与记录。

skills.name: ids-and-outcomes
skills.description: Which Topo id to pass to which MCP tool, which write records a booked meeting, a loss, a hard no, or a pause, and which writes need the user's confirmation. Read before any Topo write, and whenever unsure whether to call stop_sequence, unenroll, or refuse_leads.
skills.description_zh: 说明 Topo 各类 ID 与 MCP 工具的对应关系，以及预约会议、失单、明确拒绝或暂停的记录方法和需确认的写入，帮助区分 stop_sequence、unenroll、refuse_leads。

skills.name: importing-and-starting-outreach
skills.description: Add named people to a contact list and enroll them in an existing Topo sequence, including the hidden list membership and FOUND vs ACTIVE steps. Use when the user wants to add conference contacts, a short list of emails, or a CSV to a sequence and start outreach.
skills.description_zh: 将指定联系人加入名单并纳入既有 Topo 序列，处理隐含名单成员关系及 FOUND 到 ACTIVE 的步骤，支持会议联系人、邮件名单或 CSV 导入后启动触达。

skills.name: recording-outreach-outcomes
skills.description: Apply a known outreach outcome in Topo — meeting booked, won, not interested, unsubscribe, wrong person — using stop_sequence, unenroll, or refuse_leads. Use when the user already knows the result from a call, Slack, or CRM and wants someone taken off a sequence without opening the inbox.
skills.description_zh: 在 Topo 记录已知触达结果，如会议预约、成交、不感兴趣、退订或联系人错误，通过 stop_sequence、unenroll 或 refuse_leads 移出序列，无需打开收件箱。

skills.name: reviewing-waiting-leads
skills.description: Review leads waiting for approval (FOUND) on a sequence — qualify against the ICP, approve fits so outreach starts, refuse the rest without blocking other sequences. Use when the user asks to review new leads, approve a backlog, or refuse people who are not a fit.
skills.description_zh: 审查序列中等待批准的 FOUND 线索，按理想客户画像评估，批准匹配对象启动触达，拒绝其余对象且不影响其他序列。

skills.name: suppressing-or-releasing-targets
skills.description: Block or lift emails and company domains on the Topo exclusion list, and stop any sequences already sending to those targets. Use when the user wants a do-not-contact, asks why a lead was skipped, adds a customer or competitor list, or wants an exclusion removed.
skills.description_zh: 管理 Topo 排除名单中的邮件和公司域名屏蔽或解除，并停止已向这些对象发送的序列，支持禁止联系名单、跳过原因和排除项恢复。

skills.name: triaging-inbound-replies
skills.description: Work inbound email and LinkedIn replies in Topo — read the thread, classify intent, reply when needed, and apply the matching sequence outcome. Use when the user asks what came in overnight, who replied, what a lead said, or to handle the inbox.
skills.description_zh: 处理 Topo 收到的邮件或 LinkedIn 回复，读取讨论、分类意图、必要时回复并记录对应序列结果。
